rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот лужа! А снеговика нет!
rows.text: Look, a puddle! And the snowman is gone!
rows.heard: Look a puddle and the snowman is gone.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Где мой сторож? Его нет!
rows.text: Where's my guard? He's gone!
rows.heard: Where's my guard? He's gone.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: И моя подушка тут. Мокрая!
rows.text: And my pillow is here. It's wet!
rows.heard: And my pillow is here, it's wet.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Кто-то его унёс?
rows.text: Did someone take him?
rows.heard: Did someone take him?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Его украли! Я найду вора!
rows.text: He was stolen! I'll find the thief!
rows.heard: He was stolen, I'll find the thief.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вижу… лужу. Очень большую лужу.
rows.text: I see... a puddle. A very big puddle.
rows.heard: I see a puddle, a very big puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пахнет… тоже лужей.
rows.text: It smells... like a puddle too.
rows.heard: It smells like a puddle too.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Следов нет. Никто сюда не приходил.
rows.text: No footprints. Nobody came here.
rows.heard: No footprints. Nobody came here.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, он ушёл сам?
rows.text: So he left by himself?
rows.heard: So he left by himself.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Ушёл? У него же нет ног!
rows.text: Left? But he has no legs!
rows.heard: left but he has no legs.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Может, он улетел? Как пар?
rows.text: Maybe he flew away? Like steam?
rows.heard: Maybe he flew away, like steam.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Посмотрите на солнце. Сегодня оно сильно греет.
rows.text: Look at the sun. It's very warm today.
rows.heard: Look at the sun. It's very warm today.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот это загадка. Был сторож — а стала лужа.
rows.text: What a mystery. There was a guard, and now there's a puddle.
rows.heard: What a mystery. There was a guard and now there's a puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пропал сторож. Белый. Круглый. Очень храбрый
rows.text: Missing: one guard. White. Round. Very brave.
rows.heard: Missing one guard, White round very brave.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, а где у него нос?
rows.text: Ron, where was his nose?
rows.heard: Run, where was his nose?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Носа у него не было. Не успели.
rows.text: He didn't have a nose. We ran out of time.
rows.heard: He didn't have a nose, we ran out of time.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А вдруг он просто пошёл гулять?
rows.text: Maybe he just went for a walk?
rows.heard: Maybe he just went for a walk.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Без ног? Далеко не уйдёт.
rows.text: Without legs? He won't get far.
rows.heard: Without legs, he won't get far.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Помните, как солнце выпило лужу?
rows.text: Remember how the sun drank the puddle?
rows.heard: Remember how the sun drank the puddle.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Может, и сторожа выпило солнце?
rows.text: Maybe the sun drank the guard too?
rows.heard: Maybe the sun drank the guard too.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте лучше проверим, куда уходит снег.
rows.text: Let's find out where the snow goes.
rows.heard: Let's find out where the snow goes.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Я знаю как. Нужна миска и снежок.
rows.text: I know how. We need a bowl and a snowball.
rows.heard: I know how. We need a bowl and a snowball.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я принесу! Я быстрый!
rows.text: I'll get it! I'm fast!
rows.heard: I'll get it, I'm fast.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вот снежок! Круглый, как маленький снеговик!
rows.text: Here's a snowball! Round, like a little snowman!
rows.heard: Here's a snowball, round like a little snowman.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я буду за ним следить. Чтобы его тоже не похитили.
rows.text: I'll watch it. So nobody steals it too.
rows.heard: I'll watch it, so nobody steals it too.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А мы пока попьём чаю.
rows.text: And we'll have some tea.
rows.heard: and we'll have some tea.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ух, горячий! На кухне тепло, как летом.
rows.text: Ooh, it's hot! The kitchen is warm, like summer.
rows.heard: Ooh, it's hot. The kitchen is warm like summer.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А снежку тут нравится?
rows.text: Does the snowball like it here?
rows.heard: Does the snowball like it here?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Сейчас увидим.
rows.text: Let's see.
rows.heard: Let's see.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: После чая всегда хочется спать.
rows.text: After tea I always feel sleepy.
rows.heard: After tea, I always feel sleepy.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Топа, только не на всю зиму!
rows.text: Topa, not for the whole winter!
rows.heard: Toba not for the whole winter.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я смотрю на снежок очень внимательно. Одним глазом.
rows.text: And I'm watching the snowball very carefully. With one eye.
rows.heard: And I'm watching the snowball very carefully, with one eye.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Опять уснул.
rows.text: He fell asleep again.
rows.heard: He fell asleep again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Где снежок? Я же за ним следил!
rows.text: Where's the snowball? I was watching it!
rows.heard: Where's the snowball? I was watching it.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот миска. Что в ней?
rows.text: Look, here's the bowl. What's inside?
rows.heard: Look here's the bowl, what's inside?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Снежка нет. Одна вода!
rows.text: No snowball. Just water!
rows.heard: No snowball, just water.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Снег растаял. В тепле снег становится водой.
rows.text: The snow melted. When it's warm, snow turns into water.
rows.heard: The snow melted. When it's warm, snow turns into water.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Снежинки — это вода, только замёрзшая. Стало тепло — и снова вода.
rows.text: Snowflakes are water, only frozen. When it gets warm, it's water again.
rows.heard: Snowflakes are water, only frozen. When it gets warm, it's water again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, мой сторож — это теперь лужа?
rows.text: So my guard is a puddle now?
rows.heard: So my guard is a puddle now.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Выходит, так. Солнце его растопило.
rows.text: Looks like it. The sun melted him.
rows.heard: Looks like it. The sun melted him.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Он был такой храбрый.
rows.text: He was so brave.
rows.heard: He was so brave.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Не грусти, Рон. Снега ещё много. Слепим ещё одного!
rows.text: Don't be sad, Ron. There's lots of snow. Let's make another one!
rows.heard: Don't be sad, Ron. There's lots of snow. Let's make another one.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А он опять растает?
rows.text: Will he melt again?
rows.heard: Will he month again?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А лепить будем в тени. Там солнце не достанет.
rows.text: We'll build him in the shade. The sun can't reach there.
rows.heard: We'll build him in the shade. The sun can't reach there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда скорее! Пока не стемнело!
rows.text: Then hurry! Before it gets dark!
rows.heard: Then hurry before it gets dark.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ух! Санки еле едут. Снег стал мокрый и липкий.
rows.text: Oof! The sled barely moves. The snow is wet and sticky.
rows.heard: Oof, the sled barely moves. The snow is wet and sticky.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Это от тепла. Снег начал таять.
rows.text: That's from the warmth. The snow is starting to melt.
rows.heard: That's from the warmth, the snow is starting to melt.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Зато из липкого снега лучше лепить!
rows.text: But sticky snow is better for building!
rows.heard: But sticky snow is better for building.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот ёлка. Под ней тень.
rows.text: Look, here's a fir tree. There's shade under it.
rows.heard: Look, here's a fir tree. There's shade under it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ёлка будет ему зонтиком от солнца!
rows.text: The tree will be his umbrella from the sun!
rows.heard: The tree will be his umbrella from the sun.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Готово! Новый сторож! Теперь в тени.
rows.text: Done! A new guard! In the shade this time.
rows.heard: Done a new guard in the shade this time.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А давайте дадим ему имя.
rows.text: Let's give him a name.
rows.heard: Let's give him a name.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Пусть будет Снежок Второй!
rows.text: Let's call him Snowy the Second!
rows.heard: Let's call him Snowy the second.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Здравствуй, Снежок Второй. Не тай, пожалуйста.
rows.text: Hello, Snowy the Second. Please don't melt.
rows.heard: Hello Snowy the second, please don't melt.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотрите! Теперь я тоже белый! Я снеговик!
rows.text: Look! Now I'm white too! I'm a snowman!
rows.heard: Look now I'm white too, I'm a snowman.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Только ты тёплый. И с хвостом.
rows.text: But you're warm. And you have a tail.
rows.heard: But you're warm and you have a tail.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой. Снег за шиворотом. Холодно!
rows.text: Oh. Snow down my back. It's cold!
rows.heard: Oh snow down my back it's cold.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А наш росток? Снег над ним тает!
rows.text: What about our sprout? The snow above it is melting!
rows.heard: What about our sprout? The snow above it is melting.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот наш росток. Он на месте.
rows.text: Look, here's our sprout. It's still here.
rows.heard: Look, here's our sprout. It's still here.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Снег тает понемногу. Вода уходит в землю.
rows.text: The snow melts little by little. The water goes into the ground.
rows.heard: The snow melts little by little. The water goes into the ground.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, росток попьёт?
rows.text: So the sprout will get a drink?
rows.heard: so the sprout will get a drink.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Да. Талая вода — это его питьё на весну.
rows.text: Yes. Melted snow is its drink for spring.
rows.heard: Yes, melted snow is its drink for spring.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А если опять станет холодно?
rows.text: What if it gets cold again?
rows.heard: What if it gets cold again?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Тогда снова пойдёт снег. И укроет его.
rows.text: Then it will snow again. And cover it up.
rows.heard: Then it will snow again, and cover it up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот! Ещё одно одеяло. Запасное. Из подушки.
rows.text: Here! One more blanket. A spare one. From my pillow.
rows.heard: Here, one more blanket, a spare one from my pillow.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рон, она же мокрая!
rows.text: Ron, it's wet!
rows.heard: Ron, it's wet.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Зато мягкая.
rows.text: But it's soft.
rows.heard: but it's soft

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Хорошо, что у ростка такое одеяло.
rows.text: Good thing the sprout has such a blanket.
rows.heard: Good thing the Sprout has such a blanket.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем! Я спрашиваю, а вы отвечаете.
rows.text: Let's play! I ask, and you answer.
rows.heard: Let's play, I ask and you answer.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Начинай!
rows.text: Go ahead!
rows.heard: Go ahead.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Во что превращается снег в тепле?
rows.text: What does snow turn into when it's warm?
rows.heard: What does snow turn into when it's warm?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: В воду!
rows.text: Water!
rows.heard: Water.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Правильно! А где снеговик живёт дольше: на солнце или в тени?
rows.text: Right! And where does a snowman last longer: in the sun or in the shade?
rows.heard: Right, and where does a snowman last longer? In the sun or in the shade?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: В тени. Туда солнце не достаёт.
rows.text: In the shade. The sun can't reach there.
rows.heard: In the shade, the sun can't reach there.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А куда уходит вода, когда снег тает?
rows.text: And where does the water go when snow melts?
rows.heard: And where does the water go when snow melts?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: В землю. К ростку.
rows.text: Into the ground. To the sprout.
rows.heard: Into the ground, to the sprout.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А мой первый сторож — в лужу.
rows.text: And my first guard went into a puddle.
rows.heard: And my first guard went into a puddle.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Все ответили!
rows.text: Everyone answered!
rows.heard: Everyone answered.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Солнце садится. Становится холодно.
rows.text: The sun is setting. It's getting cold.
rows.heard: The sun is setting, it's getting cold.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот наш снеговик. Стоит в тени.
rows.text: Look, here's our snowman. Standing in the shade.
rows.heard: Look, here's our snowman, standing in the shade.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот лужа. Тут был мой сторож.
rows.text: Here's the puddle. My guard used to be here.
rows.heard: Here's the puddle, my guard used to be here.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Спокойной ночи, Снежок Второй. Стой крепко.
rows.text: Good night, Snowy the Second. Stand strong.
rows.heard: Good night, Snowy the Second. Stand strong.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: В тепле снег становится водой
rows.text: When it's warm, snow turns into water.
rows.heard: When it's warm, snow turns into water.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А что будет с лужей ночью, когда придёт мороз?
rows.text: And what will happen to the puddle tonight, when the frost comes?
rows.heard: And what will happen to the puddle tonight, when the frost comes?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Она замёрзнет? Как мой нос?
rows.text: Will it freeze? Like my nose?
rows.heard: Will it freeze, like my nose?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Не знаю. Это новая загадка.
rows.text: I don't know. That's a new mystery.
rows.heard: I don't know, that's a new mystery.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А я пойду спать. Медведям зимой можно.
rows.text: And I'm going to sleep. Bears can sleep in winter.
rows.heard: And I'm going to sleep. Bears can sleep in winter.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Завтра узнаем, что мороз сделает с лужей.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll find out what the frost does to the puddle.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll find out what the frost does to the petal.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
